name: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
description:
ColorFittings Push-Loc Hose End Fittings are precision CNC-machined for secure, clamp-free connections in low- to medium-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, PCV, vacuum, and air systems. Designed specifically for Push-Loc (barbed) hose, these fittings provide a tight, leak-resistant seal without the need for hose clamps in most applications, making them ideal for clean, efficient engine bay plumbing.

Manufactured from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings’ proprietary polishing and anodizing process, our Push-Loc fittings deliver superior strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. The multi-barb design ensures maximum hose retention while maintaining smooth flow characteristics for consistent performance.

Compatible with fuel (including E85 and ethanol blends), oil, coolant, and air systems, these Push-Loc hose ends are perfect for street performance, racing, off-road, marine, and custom fabrication projects where flexibility and ease of installation are key.

Looking to complete your system? Explore our full range of Push-Loc Fittings, Push-Loc Hose, and Fitting Assembly Tools.
